$doc: Vyomi capability registry — Systems Manager. See s3.json for the contract.

ssm.parameter.crud.title: Parameters (create, read, update, delete, history, labels, tags)

ssm.document.crud.title: Documents (create, update, versions, default version, delete)

ssm.runcommand.title: Run Command (SendCommand, command history, invocations)
limitations: Vyomi has no real SSM Agent or managed-instance fleet behind Run Command: every instance ID you target completes immediately as Success with no real command output, the same shape Run Command reports for an instance it can't actually reach.

ssm.statemanager.association.title: State Manager associations (create, list, delete)
limitations: An association's status never advances past "Pending"/"Creating" — Vyomi has no agent to run the document on a schedule and report compliance back.

ssm.maintenancewindow.crud.title: Maintenance windows (create, update, enable/disable, targets, delete)

ssm.patchbaseline.crud.title: Patch baselines (create, approval rules, approved/rejected patches, delete)
limitations: Approval rules and approved/rejected patches are stored and returned exactly as configured, but never evaluated against real instance patch compliance — there is no patch scan/install behind a baseline.

ssm.session-manager.title: Session Manager (StartSession, ResumeSession, TerminateSession, DescribeSessions)
limitations: Offline, running Docker instances register as Online managed nodes (DescribeInstanceInformation) and sessions open a command-at-a-time shell in the instance container. The ssmmessages data-channel websocket is not served, so the AWS CLI session-manager-plugin cannot attach; use the console session or ssh. Nano (v4): a running in-browser EC2 VM (nano_vm_compute on) registers as an Online managed node in the console's page and sessions run a command-at-a-time shell in that v86 Alpine VM (the console Connect > Session Manager tab); an instance without a running VM, or the SDK/CLI relay worker (which has no VM host), answers TargetNotConnected. No ssmmessages data channel, so the CLI session-manager-plugin cannot attach.
